provenance.construction: Multi-band dense packing of distance-11 surface-code patches (arXiv:2511.06758 generalized): rows=2 bands, m=5 patches per even band, band pitch 10, patch pitch Px=24. Built by research/multiband_surface.py build(d=11, rows=2, m=5, pitch=10).
provenance.notes: Generalizes the multi-band dense packing of arXiv:2511.06758 beyond its published two-band, three-patch configuration. Literature novelty is unverified: the parameters were checked for domination and duplication against this board only.
